content: I'm new, and curious if anyone has hints on effectively using git worktrees with lake. For each new worktree (of physlib) lake pulls and builds the whole world again. Is there a way to configure lake to reuse the closest build directory higher in the directory structure?
In my experience each worktree is treated as a separate local clone in a different folder. Short of creating symlinks, and hoodwinking lake, I see no way to make lake use the existing build folder
Yeah, I might just symlink .lake but it feels fragile and was hoping for a better (config?) solution. Thanks!
If you don't want to rebuild the world you can use lake exe cache pack and lake exe cache unpack
Symlinking .lake will surely cause the world to rebuild even more every time you switch
